Name: Project Initiation
Description: GROUP

Name: Problem domain selection
Description: Multi-agent LLM systems for the Colombo Stock Exchange.

Name: MSc lecture recordings, weeks 2 to 5
Description: Paper valuation, contribution to the body of knowledge, SMART gap, literature review and methodology.

Name: Topic validation with supervisor
Description: Scope overload, duplication with TradingAgents and dataset availability identified as the three main risks.

Name: Preliminary literature survey
Description: Breadth pass before the structured review.

Name: Research gap, contribution and research challenge
Description: First drafts against the Week 2 and Week 4 specifications.

Name: Research aim and objectives
Description: One-sentence aim, decomposed objectives.

Name: Scope decision, sentiment excluded
Description: Supervisor decision of 20 September, recorded Final. Sentiment papers stay in the corpus as background and as fixed-influence failure cases.

Name: Proposal period plan, 126 hours
Description: Revised down from the earlier 182-hour version. 193 atomic tasks across six gates.

Name: Literature Review
Description: GROUP

Name: Paper search and screening
Description: Semantic Scholar and Consensus with Q1 to Q3, last five years, no preprints. Four-step reading funnel.

Name: Per-paper review notes, 59 papers
Description: House structure, length budgets, voice rules and frontmatter schema.

Name: Each review note checked against its source paper
Description: Validation pass. Claim, evidence and my reading kept visibly separate in every note.

Name: Corpus index and research papers grid
Description: Index generated from the notes' own properties.

Name: Research gap statement drafted
Description: SMART form. No absolutes. Search cutoff 9 March 2026.

Name: GATE Literature and gap frozen
Description: MILESTONE. Corpus frozen at 59 reviewed papers. No further collection to raise the paper count.

Name: Research Gap final statement document
Description: Issued 20 October 2026.

Name: Gap statement re-checked before each submission
Description: The 9 March 2026 cutoff ages, and an examiner is entitled to ask when it was last tested.

Name: Structured gap verification
Description: Existing systems compared across aggregation method, regime detection, liquidity treatment and evaluation protocol.

Name: Survey matrix 374-day correction pass
Description: Roughly 20 cells across 8 review notes. A note revision with the paper check that implies, not a find and replace.

Name: Data Acquisition and Engineering
Description: GROUP

Name: CSE API extraction built and archived
Description: D22. 323 securities, 829,070 observations. Archived daily because the past cannot be re-fetched.

Name: Filings corpus harvest
Description: 22,893 documents, 2012 to October 2026, roughly 340 counters, each filename prefixed with the announcement date so the as-of cursor can filter on publication.

Name: Dataset comparison and source evaluation
Description: Catalogue rebuilt on one ID scheme. Sentiment and news rows removed, superseded price sources retired.

Name: Data Library costed and purchased
Description: Forty items at the student rate. The only official route to corporate actions.

Name: Data Library delivery and inspection
Description: Turnover reconciled to the published annual figures. Calendar validated at 3,920 trading days across 17 years.

Name: Data cleaning checklist and profiling
Description: Ten items change layout, units or meaning partway through their own history, three of them silently.

Name: Universe derivation, 359 to 233
Description: Every exclusion named. 357 in window, 356 cleaned, 355 core, 233 passing the eligibility screen.

Name: Corporate action register corrections
Description: 31 corrections, each confirmed against both price and issued quantity.

Name: Adjusted price panel built
Description: D26. Price-only adj_close and total-return tr_close. tr_close is primary against ASTRI. 259 ex-dates marked approximate, recorded as DR10.

Name: Bid, ask and depth requested from the exchange
Description: Unanswered. The proxy route is the declared fallback and needs no reply, so this blocks the enhancement rather than the plan.

Name: Dataset reconciliation and matrix patch
Description: D27 added, D22 demoted to cross-check, five status fields corrected across both matrices.

Name: Liquidity profiling and final universe
Description: D17. Run against the official D27 panel, not the API extraction.

Name: Point-in-time data layer and as-of cursor
Description: CANNOT SLIP. Point-in-time correctness cannot be retrofitted.

Name: M2 Point-in-time data layer accepted
Description: MILESTONE. The as-of cursor raises on any row past the simulation clock rather than warning, and the cursor-violation test passes.

Name: M3 Adjusted dataset accepted
Description: MILESTONE. Raw, rejected and accepted record counts reconcile to one auditable figure, and the raw, cleaned and final eligible universes are each defined with every exclusion explained.

Name: Requirements and Specification
Description: GROUP

Name: Stakeholders, users and context of use
Functional and non-functional requirements
Description: Must, Should and Could, each traceable to a test.

Name: GATE Questions, objectives, requirements and schema frozen
Description: MILESTONE.

Name: Acceptance criteria A1 to A5
Description: A3 is the one the contribution rests on: the weight vector measurably responds to liquidity with the rest held fixed.

Name: Proof of concept specification
Description: Sixteen items. Five pre-registration decisions fixed, one contested, four still open.

Name: Close the four open pre-registration items
Description: Volatility estimator, abstention floor, abstained-day exposure policy, and the final liquidity state input list.

Name: System Design
Description: GROUP

Name: Architecture and indicative solution
Description: Four heterogeneous agents, a measured state vector, and an orchestration operator that varies influence as a function of market state.

Name: Orchestration operator form
Description: The weighting form specified, with the agent set and the conditioning set both recorded as provisional.

Name: Agent output contract, six fields
Description: Declared types, and as_of equal to the cursor on every agent.

Name: GATE Change freeze
Description: MILESTONE. No new agents, datasets, research gaps or technologies after this date.

Name: Architecture, pipeline and mechanism diagrams
Description: Three draw.io diagrams. The pipeline diagram separates executed work from designed work by colour.

Name: Proposal and PPRS
Description: GROUP

Name: Proposal notes 01 to 13
Description: Title, problem, evidence, literature landscape, gap, questions, baselines, stakeholders, requirements, architecture, data strategy, methodology.

Name: Supervisor review and the section 7 corrections
Description: Implementation set aside until 5 November, recorded Final. Nine criteria assessed, the project plan the lowest at 32 of 100.

Name: Proposal notes 14 to 22
Description: Evaluation design, testing and QA, iteration and AI verification, project plan, risk, responsible considerations, scope, academic practice, backup and Q&A.

Name: Deck build, 22 slides
Description: Built from the issued template against the marking rubric.

Name: Reference list, Westminster Harvard
Description: 59 papers plus the non-paper sources, generated from the Zotero library.

Name: Backup slides
Description: Eight, against the anticipated questions.

Name: Ethics application signed
Description: CRITICAL. A qualifying condition for the entire proposal mark. Non-submission scores zero regardless of the deck.

Name: M1 PP submission
Description: MILESTONE. Slides submitted, signed Ethics Application submitted, and every section 7 data inconsistency either reconciled or stated as outstanding with a reason.

Name: Implementation
Description: GROUP

Name: Technical agent
Description: A_T. Runs on the adjusted panel.

Name: Liquidity agent
Description: A_L. Proxy-based: volume, zero-volume frequency, zero-return frequency, turnover and Amihud. Guaranteed feasible without the exchange reply.

Name: Volatility agent
Description: A_V. Estimator choice is one of the four open pre-registration items.

Name: Four agents behind one contract
Description: Every agent returning all six fields end to end on one ticker-date.

Name: M4 Four agents behind one contract
Description: MILESTONE. Every agent returns all six fields with declared types and as_of equal to the cursor, on one ticker-date end to end.

Name: Fundamental agent on the filings corpus
Description: A_F. Retrieval over 22,893 filings. Model backbone is an open decision. Fallback is to stub it against a probe set while keeping it emitting the contract.

Name: M5 Fundamental agent live
Description: MILESTONE. It answers from retrieved filings with every argument traceable to a retrieved figure, and usable coverage measured against a probe set rather than assumed.

Name: State vector construction
Description: Liquidity, volatility and participation, measured rather than declared.

Name: Orchestrator and weighting operator
Description: CANNOT SLIP. Scheduled eight days before IPD so there is time to respond if the weights turn out inert.

Name: M6 Orchestrator responds to state
Description: MILESTONE. A3 passes: the weight vector measurably responds to liquidity with the rest held fixed, with the sensitivity sweep plotted. Inert weights are a finding, not a build failure.

Name: Five-arm evaluation harness
Description: Arms consume byte-identical cached agent outputs, which is what makes the comparison fair and costs one agent pass rather than five.

Name: M8 Feature complete
Description: MILESTONE. No Must requirement untested, and the cost term sits inside the allocation objective rather than being deducted after it.

Name: Cost term inside the allocation objective
Description: Inside the objective, not deducted after it.

Name: Testing and Evaluation
Description: GROUP

Name: Unit and integration suite
Description: Runs across the whole twelve weeks rather than one block, because the tests that protect properties which cannot be retrofitted have to exist before the components they guard.

Name: Cursor-violation test
Description: Guards the one ordering rule the build protects.

Name: Must-requirement test coverage
Description: Every Must requirement has a test that runs, which is an IPD condition.

Name: Persistence re-levering experiment
Description: The one explicitly unblocked path. Runs on a published paper's own four-ETF environment and needs no CSE data.

Name: Five arms, ablations and regime decomposition
Description: Per-input and per-agent ablations, which is what measures whether each agent earns its vote.

Name: M9 Evaluation complete
Description: MILESTONE. Five arms over byte-identical cached agent outputs, all ablations, regime decomposition, and the diagnostics reported whether or not they are favourable.

Name: Significance and stability sweeps
Description: 16 folds, HAC-adjusted test plus stationary bootstrap at alpha 0.05. A null result was decided in advance to be acceptable and will be reported.

Name: Documentation and Dissertation
Description: GROUP

Name: Chapters 1, 4, 5 and 6
Description: Required at IPD.

Name: M7 IPD
Description: MILESTONE. A working prototype, every Must requirement has a test that runs, and chapters 1, 4, 5 and 6 drafted.

Name: Thesis writing
Description: Runs the full nine weeks beside the build rather than following it, because nine weeks will not hold both in sequence.

Name: Viva preparation
Description: The viva is unresolved: the proforma carries a 20 percent viva of up to 45 minutes, the deadline list carries one 70 percent final submission with no viva named.

Name: M10 Final submission
Description: MILESTONE. Thesis, artefact and code submitted, and the pipeline reproducible from a clean environment.

Name: Supervisor and Admin
Description: GROUP

Name: Supervisor meeting cycle
Description: Recorded meetings on 8 August, 13 September, 20 September, 29 September and 24 October, each written up with decisions marked Final or provisional.

Name: Carry the viva question to the supervisor
Description: The proforma and the deadline list do not reconcile on whether a viva exists.
